answer: To prevent Sybil flooding, the network models interaction flows across nodes, routing audit tasks like cargo through a wharf. Nodes register cryptographically bound deposits; any topological cut verification isolating suspicious subgraphs triggers game-theoretic multi-agent auditing. If an adversarial whisper of fraudulent claims is uncovered, consensus burns offending collateral down to the last ember. This stake slashing scales verification boundaries, imposing superlinear attacker cost as the cluster expands.
